package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// One test copies a built binary through a variable named raw; another, in a
// separate function, declares its own raw holding a shell script and writes it
// 0o755. The spelling is shared, the variable is not: only the copy is the
// offender, and the script is exempt as it is anywhere else.
func TestFixtureCopiesABuiltBinary(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("built")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("placed", raw, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestFixtureWritesAShellScriptUnderTheSameName(t *testing.T) {
	raw := []byte("#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n")
	if err := os.WriteFile("tool", raw, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
